title: Tenlai-TTS 2.0: Continuous-Representation LLM-Based TTS System with End-to-End Training
abstract: arXiv:2611.29226v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autoregressive text-to-speech (TTS) with continuous speech latents avoids quantization-induced information loss, but typically relies on a latent space that is learned separately and then frozen before language-model training. Such a space must satisfy two competing requirements: it must retain enough acoustic detail for high-fidelity reconstruction, yet be sufficiently structured and regularized to support autoregressive prediction by a language model. We present Tenlai-TTS 2.0, which learns continuous speech representations through end-to-end training to balance acoustic detail with autoregressive predictability. The model comprises a speech encoder with a capacity-controlled Gaussian bottleneck, a large language model (LLM) with an autoregressive diffusion transformer (AR-DiT) head, a flow-matching (FM) mel-spectrogram decoder, and a multi-task recognition model (RM). translated_title: Tenlai-TTS 2.0：基于端到端训练的连续表示大语言模型语音合成系统
translated_abstract: 基于连续语音潜变量的自回归文本转语音（TTS）避免了量化引起的信息损失，但通常依赖于一个单独学习并在语言模型训练之前被冻结的潜空间。这样的潜空间必须满足两个相互冲突的要求：既要保留足够的声学细节以实现高保真重建，又要具备足够的结构化和正则化特性以支持语言模型的自回归预测。我们提出了Tenlai-TTS 2.0，它通过端到端训练学习连续语音表示，以平衡声学细节与自回归可预测性。该模型由以下部分组成：一个具有容量控制高斯瓶颈的语音编码器、一个带有自回归扩散变换器（AR-DiT）头的大语言模型（LLM）、一个流匹配（FM）梅尔频谱图解码器，以及一个多任务识别模型（RM）。通过能量归一化和固定方差高斯噪声，该……
tldr: Tenlai-TTS 2.0通过端到端训练学习连续语音表示，将容量控制高斯瓶颈编码器、带AR-DiT头的LLM、流匹配解码器与多任务识别模型相结合，在保留声学细节与保证自回归可预测性之间取得平衡，摆脱了传统方法中潜空间需预先学习并冻结的限制。
en_tdlr: Tenlai-TTS 2.0 learns continuous speech representations through end-to-end training, balancing acoustic detail retention with autoregressive predictability via a capacity-controlled Gaussian bottleneck encoder, an LLM with an AR-DiT head, a flow-matching decoder, and a multi-task recognition model.
